summary: CI only: main commit publishers now use independent source-commit concurrency groups without cancellation. Manual publication accepts a full commit SHA, checks out that exact revision, and requires it to be an ancestor of current main before building or publishing. Explicit tag-free history fetching avoids downloading evidence tags.

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

schema.detail: No schema change; publication artifacts retain their format.

rules.detail: CI only; no runtime or admission rules change and no required check is added.

compatibility.detail: Published package identity is unchanged; dispatch selects its exact main commit.

manual.detail: No upgrade action required. Optional backfills dispatch nix.yml on main with the full sha input.
